data.narrative:
Mission Zero Technologies, founded by Nicholas Chadwick, Shiladitya Ghosh, and Gaël Gobaille-Shaw, is a Series A climate and energy company that has raised £21.8M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 9 comparable companies across the Climate & Energy sector—1 public (LNZA) and 8 private firms including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x multiplier to the £21.8M total raised, treating this as a proxy for pre-Series A valuation. This method yields an implied Series A valuation of £44M. A peer-median approach was not applicable; while 8 same-sector comparables exist, none met the narrow filter criteria of same-stage or adjacent-stage positioning with sufficient datapoint density (minimum 3 required), making sector-wide medians unreliable.

The analysis supports a valuation range of £37M–£50M, centered on a median of £44M. This range reflects the single methodologically sound input available. Key uncertainties include the absence of sufficiently dense stage-matched peer data—which would normally anchor relative valuation—and reliance on a stage-progression assumption that may not reflect market conditions specific to frontier-tech climate solutions. Additional clarity on revenue, burn rate, and technology maturity would materially strengthen conviction in this range.
